summary: The learner got 1 of 6 right on Adding Fractions. The work shows one habit: adding the top numbers together and the bottom numbers together, which was wrong in problems 1, 2, 3, 4 and 6. Problem 5 was right because the bottom numbers were already the same. When working together, first make the bottom numbers match, then add only the tops. The practice sheet has 5 problems that target exactly that.
